spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Inside a small theatre in the dark: warm stage spotlights have just switched on and flood an empty stage framed by red curtains. Seen from behind, the woman and the man sit side by side in the audience seats, silhouetted against the bright stage. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
